name: top10_geography
sql: SELECT concat_ws(' · ',d.province_name,d.geography_version,d.province_code) AS label,sum(f.award_amount_sum) AS amount FROM fact_award_daily f JOIN dim_geography d USING(geography_key) WHERE f.currency_key='VND' AND f.geography_key NOT IN ('GEO_UNKNOWN','GEO_MULTI_UNALLOCATED') GROUP BY geography_key,label ORDER BY amount DESC,geography_key ASC LIMIT 10

name: top10_supplier
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.party_name IS NULL OR trim(d.party_name)='' THEN 'Chưa có tên' ELSE d.party_name END || ' [' || d.party_key || ']' AS label,sum(f.award_amount_sum)/1000000000 AS amount FROM fact_supplier_daily f JOIN dim_party d USING(party_key) WHERE f.currency_key='VND' AND f.recipient_allocation_state='single_recipient' AND f.eligible_amount_count>0 AND d.party_kind<>'UNKNOWN' GROUP BY party_key,label ORDER BY amount DESC,party_key ASC LIMIT 10
